sources.name: NHDOT 10 Year Plan - Planning Projects (copy in The Nature Conservancy's NH_Transportation_Source_Data)
sources.authority: New Hampshire DOT (copy hosted by The Nature Conservancy)
sources.planned_filter: All records are PROJECT_TYPE 'Planning' and IS_TEN_YEAR 'YES' at the time of the copy; drop any whose L2In_Planning_AD_DATE is in the past.
sources.sample: {"L2In_Planning_PROJ_NUMBER": "29055", "L2In_Planning_PROJ_NAME": "RICHMOND", "L2In_Planning_PROJ_DESCRIPTION": "BRIDGE REPLACEMENT-WHIPPLE HILL RD OVER ROARING BROOK-BR. #065/083", "L2In_Planning_PROJECT_TYPE": "Planning", "L2In_Planning_PROJECT_DOLLARS": "     $3,414,378", "L2In_Planning_AD_DATE": 1721088000000}
sources.notes: THIRD-PARTY, STALE copy: NHDOT's own 'Projects In Planning' layer (maps.dot.nh.gov Projects/NHDOT_PROJECTS_PROPOSALS) exported by TNC; BUILD_DATE 2023-11, layer last edited 2024-03. Only the planning-stage Ten Year Plan projects (105 lines). Same schema as NHDOT's layer incl. HAS_ROW_PLANS, TYP_PROJECT_SHEET (PDF link per project), PROJECT_DOLLARS as padded text. NHDOT's own server still returns error 500 on every query, find and identify call (re-tested 2026-11-17), so this is the only copy with real records found. Use as a stopgap.

sources.name: Nashua Regional Planning Commission MPO Projects Map - Ten-Year Plan Projects (Lines)
sources.planned_filter: OBLIGATED = 'No' (not yet funded for construction); YEAR is the planned year
sources.sample: {"PROJECTNO": "42593", "LOCATION": "Future Baboosic Greenway", "SUMMARY": "Construct rail trail between Baboosic Lake Rd and Walnut Hill Rd", "TYPE": "Bike-Ped", "COST": "$852,566", "STATUS": "Active", "YEAR": "2029", "MUN": "Amherst"}
sources.notes: Nashua region only (13 towns). Service has 8 layers: 0-3 points and 4-7 lines for MTP (long-range), Ten-Year Plan, TIP and Obligated projects; flags TIP/TYP/MTP say which plans a project is in. Last edited 2023-08, so it reflects the 2023-2026 TIP. COST is text.

sources.name: ArDOT STIP 2023-2026 lines (STIP_2023_2026_Web_Map, real attribute fields)
sources.planned_filter: Federal_Fi >= current federal fiscal year (values 2023-2026, 0 = unscheduled). New_Locati = 1 marks new-location jobs (27 lines), Job_Type = 'Capacity' marks widening.
sources.notes: Previous STIP cycle (edited 2023-09), but unlike the current 2025-2028 KML-import layer on gis.ardot.gov it has proper fields: job name, scope of work, job type (7 values), cost estimate (looks like $ thousands), federal fiscal year, new-location flag. Use it to enrich the 2025-2028 layer by Job_No (the job number is in that layer's popupinfo HTML). Layer 0 is the point version (same schema). County_No is ArDOT's county number, not a name.

sources.name: ArDOT Highway Study E-Library - study corridors (DISPLAY_LINES)
sources.planned_filter: Date >= 2018 (year of the study; 8 lines dated 2020 or later) and Document_Type in ('AHC Planning Study','Environmental','Interchange Justification Report','Toll Feasibility')
sources.sample: {"Library_Nu": "1.01.005", "Title": "Forrest City Western Bypass Feasibility Report", "Document_Type": "AHC Planning Study", "Date": 1974, "County": "St. Francis"}
sources.notes: Corridor lines for every planning, bypass, feasibility and environmental study ArDOT holds since the 1970s (346 lines), each with a PDF link (SharepointLink). Most are historical; recent ones are early signals of new-location and widening corridors (e.g. Highway 412 Corridor Planning Study Update, 2020). Layer 9 is the same as multipoints. No cost or status.

sources.name: ArDOT public-involvement design map, example: Job 012366 Springdale Bypass - Proposed Right-of-Way (one service per job)
sources.planned_filter: Every such service is a project still in design (public-involvement stage). Take the layers named 'Proposed Right-of-Way', 'Temporary Construction Easement', 'Proposed Construction Limits' and 'Potential Relocations'.
sources.notes: PATTERN SOURCE, high value for land acquisition: ArDOT publishes the CAD design of each job taken to a public meeting as its own hosted service, with the proposed right-of-way line, construction limits, easements and (here, layer 9) 'Potential Relocations' polygons. The job number is in the service name; attributes are CAD leftovers (Layer, Linetype), so join to the STIP by job number. Discover them by listing https://services.arcgis.com/7cbqsWqMe170dJ3k/arcgis/rest/services?f=json (765 services on 2026-11-17, about 115 matching Job_|ROW|Right_of_Way|Plans|VPI) and https://gis.ardot.gov/hosting/rest/services/Hosted?f=json (e.g. Job_070367_Interactive_Web_Map_Nov_2026 with 'Acquired Right-of-Way'). Service names carry the month, e.g. Job_080675_Roadway_Plans_October_2026, Job_101119_Roadway_Plans_October_2026.

sources.name: RTC Southern Nevada - All RTC Roadway Projects (Las Vegas valley)
sources.authority: Regional Transportation Commission of Southern Nevada (funds county/city/NDOT road projects in Clark County)
sources.planned_filter: MPO_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND MPO_PHASE IN ('Design','Design Complete','Soon to Advertise','Advertise','Pending Construction'); record_count given is for MPO_STATUS='ACTIVE' (856 lines in total incl. completed).
sources.sample: {"RTC_PROJ_NUM": "160B-FTI2", "PROJECT_NAME": "160B-FTI2, Allen Ln - Craig Rd to Centennial Pkwy", "PROJ_DESCRIPTION": "Allen Ln - Craig Rd to Centennial Pkwy", "PROJECT_COST": 692000.0, "MPO_PHASE": "Design", "JURISDICTION": "City of North Las Vegas"}
sources.notes: Closes most of the Nevada gap by population: RTC-funded street and highway projects of Clark County, Las Vegas, North Las Vegas, Henderson, Boulder City, Mesquite. PROJECT_STATUS (13 values) is the finer status; EST_DESIGN_START/END, EST_NTP, EST_CONSTR_START/END are schedule dates; PROJECT_COST appears to be $ thousands; FROM_STREET/TO_STREET give limits. Refreshed from RTC's project database (last_edited_date 2026-08). Layers 1 and 2 are the unjoined geometry.

sources.name: RTC Southern Nevada Regional Transportation Plan 2025 projects - lines (RTP25 Projects ML1)
sources.authority: Regional Transportation Commission of Southern Nevada (MPO); sponsors include NDOT
sources.planned_filter: All are plan projects; FundingYear (number) / FundingYear5Y (e.g. '2030-2035') give timing. Sponsor IN ('NDOT','NDOT Freight') selects state highway projects.
sources.notes: Long-range plan for the Las Vegas region incl. NDOT freeway projects. Layer 0 = point (multipoint) projects (33), layer 1 = unfunded spot projects, layer 3 = unfunded corridor projects. No cost field; Project_Limits is free text.

sources.name: RTC Washoe 2050 Regional Transportation Plan project listing - funded lines (Reno/Sparks)
sources.authority: Regional Transportation Commission of Washoe County (MPO and road builder)
sources.planned_filter: All planned. F2025_2034 = 'X' is the first ten years, F2035_2050 = 'X' later; Type IN ('Capacity','Freeway') are widening and new roads (most likely to take land).
sources.sample: {"WR_ID": "P96", "Project": "Peckham - Multimodal", "Descriptio": "Lakeside Dr to Airway Dr", "Type": "Multimodal", "Cost_Estim": 15100000, "Domain": "Multimodal & AT Program 2025 - 2034"}
sources.notes: Item updated 2026-01. Layer 2 = unfunded lines (69), layer 5 = privately funded (developer) roads, layers 0/4/6 points. Cost_Estim in dollars. Freeway type covers NDOT projects in the region.

sources.name: Jackson MPO (CMPDD) 2045 Metropolitan Transportation Plan - Fiscally Constrained Capacity Projects
sources.authority: Central Mississippi Planning & Development District (Jackson MPO); projects built by MDOT, counties and cities
sources.planned_filter: All are planned widening / new-road projects. stage: 'Stage I' = nearest term, 'Stage III' = latest. funding = 'MDOT' selects state projects. improvemen LIKE 'New%' = new-location roads.
sources.notes: First Mississippi source with geometry: Hinds, Madison, Rankin counties only. Every record is capacity work (17 improvement types such as 'Widen to 6 Lanes', 'New 4 Lane Roadway', 'New Frontage Roads'), the kind that needs right of way. Many segments per project (join on project_id); 17 of 187 segments have blank attributes (count given is the filled ones). Layer 5 = Visionary (unfunded) capacity projects, 3/4 = non-capacity. No cost or year.

sources.name: Jackson MPO (CMPDD) TIP 2025-2028 viewer - MDOT Projects
sources.authority: Central Mississippi Planning & Development District (Jackson MPO) / Mississippi DOT
sources.planned_filter: All are programmed TIP projects; fiscalyear gives the year.
sources.sample: {"name": "Madison County Debt Service I-55", "descriptio": "MS 463 Improvements from Post Oak Road to US Hwy 51", "classifica": "Reconstruction", "fiscalyear": "2025-2026", "county": "Madison"}
sources.notes: Small: one service per TIP cycle with a layer per category (0 bridge, 2 safety, 3 congestion mitigation, 5 MDOT, 6 resurfacing, 7 transportation alternatives). A 2027-2030 service exists (Hosted/TIP_Viewer_2027_2030 and MPO_Awarded_Projects_2027_2030) but its MDOT layer was still empty on 2026-11-17 and its other layers are only partly filled. termini = limits; sponsor; pdf link.

sources.name: Wichita Area MPO (WAMPO) TIP 2027-2030 All Projects (carries KDOT project IDs)
sources.authority: Wichita Area Metropolitan Planning Organization; lead agencies KDOT, Wichita, Sedgwick County and cities
sources.planned_filter: All are programmed for FFY 2027-2030. ProjectType IN ('RN - New Roadway','RX - Roadway Expansion (add through lanes)','RM - Roadway Reconstruction/Modernization','BR - Bridge') are the land-taking kinds. LeadAgency = 'KDOT' for state projects.
sources.sample: {"WAMPO_ID": "B-20-01", "ProjectTitle": "Replace Bridge #184 on K-15 in Sedgwick County", "ProjectScope": "Bridge Replacement", "ProjectType": "BR - Bridge", "Total_Cost": 5514000, "TIP_Action_27_30": "Carry Over Project (Unchanged)", "LeadAgency": "KDOT"}
sources.notes: Official, current (edited 2026-11-05). KDOT_Project_ID (e.g. KA-5770-01) links to KDOT's WinCPMS. Project_Limits is free text. Kansas statewide is still only the consultant-hosted centroid copy: KDOT's own server kanplan.ksdot.gov (Transportation/Projects_KHUB and APPS/WinCPMS_KHUB MapServer, listed on ArcGIS Online by owner KanDOT, modified 2025-12) and wfs.ksdot.org did not resolve/connect on 2026-11-17.

sources.name: Indianapolis MPO Metropolitan Transportation Plan projects - current (MTP_2024Q3)
sources.authority: Indianapolis Metropolitan Planning Organization; sponsors INDOT, counties and cities
sources.planned_filter: All are plan projects; Time_Perio gives the period (e.g. '2020-2029 (E&C)'). Sponsor = 'INDOT' for state projects. Imprv_Type is free text such as 'Widen from 4 lanes to 6 lanes', 'New 2-lane road'.
sources.sample: {"PROJ_ID": 6042, "Descriptio": "US 36 from Raceway Rd to I-465", "Imprv_Type": "Widen from 4 lanes to 6 lanes", "Total_Cost": 24576813, "Time_Perio": "2020-2029 (E&C)", "Sponsor": "INDOT"}
sources.notes: Capacity (widening / new road / interchange) projects of the eight-county Indianapolis region, i.e. the ones that need right of way. Item 'MTP Projects - Current' updated 2026-02; layer data dated 2024-07. No status field.

sources.name: INDOT STIP/TIP joined projects FY2026-2030 (INDOT's STIP consultant, partial)
sources.authority: Indiana DOT / Indiana MPOs (hosted by INDOT's STIP consultant)
sources.planned_filter: All programmed FY2026-2030. Join_Pha_2 is the phase code (PE, RW = right of way, CN = construction); Join_FY26..Join_FY30 hold dollars by year as text.
sources.sample: {"Join_DES": "2100030", "Join_Proje": "Traffic Signals Modernization", "Join_Locat": "Traffic Signal Modernization on SR 2 At intersection of SR55 W JCT (Grant St), Project diameter is 0.1 miles", "Join_Prima": "HSIP", "Join_Estim": "$266,560", "Join_Pha_2": "CN", "Join_Count": "LAKE"}
sources.notes: Only 133 records (looks like MPO-area projects, e.g. NIRPC), but it is the only Indiana layer found that has phase (incl. RW) and dollars by fiscal year; DES number joins to the STIP_2024 layer already recorded. Third-party host; edited 2026-06. INDOT's own server gis.indot.in.gov still returns HTTP 403 (re-tested 2026-11-17), so no official INDOT replacement was found.

sources.name: MAPA (Omaha-Council Bluffs MPO) 2050 Metropolitan Transportation Plan projects - lines
sources.authority: Metropolitan Area Planning Agency; lead agencies NDOT, Iowa DOT, Omaha, Douglas/Sarpy counties and cities
sources.planned_filter: MTP_Est_Construction_Year >= current year; Grouped_Category = 'Expansion' for widening / new roads. State field separates Nebraska from Iowa.
sources.sample: {"MTP_ID": 807, "Project_Name": "Fort Street", "MTP_Project_Description": "This project will extend Fort Street from", "Grouped_Category": "Expansion", "MTP_Est_Construction_Year": 2015, "County": "Douglas"}
sources.notes: Best Nebraska substitute while NDOT's own server is unreachable: 1,175 line projects compiled from the MPO plan, the TIP, Omaha/Bellevue/La Vista/Papillion CIPs and Sarpy County one-and-six-year plans (Planning_Origin says which). Contains past years too, so filter on year. Lead_Agency identifies NDOT projects. Edited 2025-09. Companion MTP_Projects_Point_view.

sources.name: MAPA FY2026 TIP projects - lines (Omaha-Council Bluffs)
sources.planned_filter: All programmed in the FY2026 TIP; control_num is the NDOT control number (NE-xxxxx) or Iowa DOT number.
sources.notes: Layers 1 (points) and 3 (polygons) hold the rest of the TIP. tip_category e.g. 'Automotive/Roadway'; lead_agency; fund_source. No phase or year fields.

sources.name: Lincoln MPO 2050 LRTP roadway project prioritization - linear projects (consultant web map)
sources.authority: Lincoln MPO / City of Lincoln, Lancaster County, NDOT (hosted by the plan's consultant)
sources.planned_filter: All are candidate or committed roadway projects of the plan being written in 2026. ProjStatus LIKE 'Committed%' = funded (TIP, HSIP, local, developer); blank = candidate.
sources.notes: 133 roadway capacity projects incl. NDOT's West Beltway (US 77) and South Beltway work; ProjectDes says e.g. 'Freeway with new interchanges', '2 lanes + turn lanes'. Proj_Limit gives limits. Layer 0 = point (intersection) projects. Third-party host, edited 2026-03; may be withdrawn when the plan is adopted. Lincoln's own TIP layer (services1.arcgis.com/wpJGOi6N4Rq5cqFv/.../TIP_Program_Projects, 535 points) is the official alternative but thin.

sources.name: NCDOT Right of Way GIS - Proposed Acquisition: ROW Left (new right-of-way polygons per parcel)
sources.authority: North Carolina DOT Right of Way Unit
sources.planned_filter: No status or date. ProjectID = STIP number + '_ROWGIS' (e.g. B5326_ROWGIS -> STIP B-5326): keep parcels whose STIP project is still in the NCDOT STIP layer (already recorded) with a right-of-way or construction year not yet past.
sources.sample: {"ProjectParcelID": "B5326_5", "ProjectID": "B5326_ROWGIS", "LevelName": "Exist Deed Draft Right of Way Left"}
sources.notes: TOP FIND for land acquisition: the actual areas NCDOT plans to acquire, as polygons per project parcel, from its right-of-way plans. One layer per take type and side: 116/117 ROW Left/Right (28,027 in 116), 120/121 temporary drainage easement, 123/124 temporary construction easement (23,059 in 123), 126/127 temporary utility, 130-149 permanent easements (construction, conservation, drainage, utility, aerial utility), 151/152 remnants, 154 Existing Parcel Shape (65,937 whole affected parcels), 106 parcel number polygons, 2 Property Owner (owner names as map annotation: TextString, e.g. an owner's name, with ProjectID; 226,755 text pieces, long names split over several). ProjectParcelID = project + parcel number (B5326_5). maxRecordCount 1000. Covers past and current projects together. Sibling folder RowMS has ProposedProperty / ProposedRoad / ExistingProperty CAD layers (e.g. 'Prop ROW Marker').

sources.name: SCDOT statewide Long Range Transportation Plan projects - corridors (LRTPCorridorProjects)
sources.authority: South Carolina DOT with the state's MPOs, COGs and sales-tax counties
sources.planned_filter: ProjectSta NOT IN ('Complete','Completed','Completed - Recently','Substantially Complete','Under Construction','Construction','Awarded'); for land: ProjectTyp IN ('Road Widening','Widening','Widenings','New Location','New Road','Extension','New Interchange','Corridor Improvement','Corridor Improvements'). ProjectSta values 'Right of Way Acquisition', 'Right-of-Way', 'ROW Acquisition' mark projects buying land now.
sources.notes: CURRENT replacement for the stale October 2023 SCDOT snapshot: edited 2026-11-02, in SCDOT's own ArcGIS Online org. Compiles long-range plan projects reported by 29 agencies (ReportingA: MPOs such as GPATS, CHATS, COATS; COGs; sales-tax counties such as Charleston, Horry, York). ProjectFun = funding (LRTP, Local Option Sales Tax...). AlreadyonP = 'Yes' means already a programmed SCDOT project (ProjectID like P031970). Values are free text entered by each agency, so 30 status spellings and 31 type spellings; Anticipate (cost) is text; many rows lack a description. Companion layers same schema: LRTPIntersectionProjects (1,580 multipoints) and LRTPBridgeProjects (265 multipoints).

sources.name: SCDOT statewide Long Range Transportation Plan projects - intersections (LRTPIntersectionProjects)
sources.planned_filter: Same as the corridor layer: drop completed / under-construction statuses.
sources.sample: {"ProjectID": "P031970", "Name": "S-37 (JP Stevens Rd) @ W Cherry & S-65 (JP Stevens Rd) @ Martin Creek Rd", "Descriptio": " ", "ProjectTyp": "Intersection Improvement", "Anticipate": " ", "ProjectSta": "Design/Development", "ProjectYr": "2027", "CountyID": 37}
sources.notes: Point (multipoint) companion to LRTPCorridorProjects, edited 2026-11-02. LRTPBridgeProjects (same org, 265 records, ProjectTyp e.g. 'New Bridge') is the bridge companion.

unverified.name: NDOT (Nevada) own GIS servers and eSTIP
unverified.reason: Re-tested 2026-11-17: /arcgis, /rhgis and /agsphs all answer HTTP 500; estip.nevadadot.com and gis.nevadadot.com did not connect. NDOT's ArcGIS Online org (services1.arcgis.com/9Y4hSlLf13E9S0Eo, 58 services listed) has no STIP, work-program or planned-project layer. No statewide Nevada source exists that a program can read today.

unverified.name: MDOT (Mississippi) GeoServer project geometry (WFS Proj_Data:FMS_PROJ_GEOM_X)
unverified.reason: MDOT's public project map (path.mdot.ms.gov/ProjMap) names this GeoServer in its script, but the server answered HTTP 403 Forbidden to a direct request, so it is not open to automated readers; no further attempts made. The map itself lists only 'Under Construction' and 'Construction Complete' projects. No ArcGIS service for MDOT exists (gis.mdot.ms.gov does not connect, maps.mdot.ms.gov returns 500). Mississippi statewide remains a gap; STIP is a PDF.

unverified.name: KDOT WinCPMS / Projects KHUB (official Kansas project layers)
unverified.reason: Listed on ArcGIS Online by owner KanDOT (modified 2025-12-11; also APPS/WinCPMS_KHUB/MapServer and wfs.ksdot.org/.../Transportation/WinCPMS/MapServer/0), but kanplan.ksdot.gov, kanplan.ksdot.org and wfs.ksdot.org did not resolve or connect from the research machine or from a second fetch service on 2026-11-17. Likely the right official source; retest from another network.

unverified.name: NDOT (Nebraska) Program Book 2027 layers
unverified.reason: Confirmed as the data behind NDOT's public 'Program Book 2027' web app (ArcGIS Online item 6f5b199003864bbb83586221a08c7a74 references layers 0 and 1 of this service; a sibling RightOfWayDOT/FeatureServer 'Right of Ways of Nebraska' also exists). gis.ne.gov resolves through public DNS to 164.119.176.149 but the connection timed out on every attempt, and a second fetch service could not resolve it; NDOT's ArcGIS Online org (services6.arcgis.com/ljihus0RxqhjsxEd) holds only 4 unrelated services. Retest from another network: this is almost certainly the right source.

unverified.name: NHDOT project layers (Projects In Planning / In Design / Ten Year Plan / ROW projects)
unverified.reason: Re-tested 2026-11-17: layer definitions answer but query, find and identify all return error 500 on every Projects service (NHDOT_PROJECTS_ALL, _PROPOSALS, _PROPOSALS_ROW, _BY_TYPE). Server-side fault at NHDOT; the stale third-party copy recorded under sources is the stopgap.

unverified.reason: Not found. The RIDOA folder (17 services) still has only the FFY18-27 STIP map services; the RIDOT folder has assets only (Bridge, Rhodeways, signs); RIDOT's ArcGIS Online org (services5.arcgis.com/JfTJE9T2RFfUZzVx, 44 services) has sweeping, bridge condition and municipal road-fund layers but no STIP; Statewide Planning's org has only the small LRTP ProposedProjects_Line already recorded.
